en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense historic city quarter with tiled roofs. Dominating the hill in the background is an enormous neo‑baroque palace complex with a central dome and multiple pavilions, terraces and retaining walls. To the right, a broad river runs through the scene, crossed by a suspension bridge with stone towers resembling 19th‑century chain bridges. The foreground shows a large, ornate public building facing a tree‑lined street. The image appears to be an old photographic postcard with no visible printed caption on the front.
